title: Slushie Bar Salts Strawberry Watermelon Bubblegum 10ml E-Liquid
description: Strawberry Watermelon Bubblegum from Slushie Bar Salts is a fun and flavoursome blend that marries the succulence of Strawberries and Watermelons with the nostalgic, carefree charm of juicy Bubblegum. This e-liquid captures the essence of summer with its bright, fruity notes, complemented by the playful sweetness of bubblegum. The inhale starts with the juicy, sun-ripened flavours of Strawberries, delivering a natural sweetness that's instantly recognizable and instantly delicious. This is then paired with the luscious and refreshing taste of Watermelon, adding a delicate, hydrating quality to the e-liquid. The sugary, fruity, bubblegum element ties these flavours together to perfection, adding a fun, candy-like twist that makes each puff a joyous experience that fruit and candy fans shouldn’t miss. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend hits the sweet spot between flavour and cloud production and the unique nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter kits and pod devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts. If you enjoy this flavour, there are plenty more Slushie Bar Salts flavours to try. Few e-liquid makers have mastered the icy joys of slushy flavours quite like Slushie, a UK company who are behind an irresistible line of 50ml and 100ml shortfill and Nic Salts e-liquids that blend mouth-watering fruit flavours with healthy doses of icy menthol for an unparalleled slushy vaping experience. We’re also thrilled to stock Slushy Bar Salts: Nic Salt e-liquids that capture the intense flavour and satisfaction of your favourite disposable vape flavours in handy 10ml bottles for use with a wide variety of MTL (mouth-to-lung) vape kits.
